sequences.name: source-mapping-repair
sequences.expected: Only first offset_u changes; library, both assets, sibling UVs, all geometry and both motion streams remain exact.

sequences.name: image-selection-repair
sequences.expected: Only first image selection changes; declared asset set and bytes, library, sibling, geometry and motion remain exact.

sequences.name: invalid-candidate-rollback
sequences.expected: Accepted revision and all accepted asset bytes remain unchanged.

sequences.name: generated-occurrence-repair
sequences.expected: Only middle mapping and its explicitly coupled mount_x change; left/right library/assets/mapping/motion remain exact. This case does not claim unchanged middle geometry placement.

sequences.name: stale-asset-replace
sequences.request_recipe: Replace label with a descriptor whose expected_sha256 differs from the original; accepted revision unchanged.

sequences.name: atomic-asset-replacement
sequences.request_recipe: Starting rgb-panel, replace label bytes with asymmetric-rgba and patch the exact source digest in the same candidate; both effects commit together. Omitting the digest patch fails OKL-E-ASSET-CLOSURE.

sequences.name: duplicate-asset-change
sequences.request_recipe: Touch one original asset ID twice in one candidate; no accepted source/asset changes.

sequences.name: asset-slice-roundtrip
sequences.request_recipe: Read one accepted asset through exact asset selector in small chunks, include EOF request; concatenate decoded slices and match original PNG SHA/length. No cursor/run/time/frame allowed with asset_slice.

sequences.name: fresh-host-reauthorization
sequences.request_recipe: Accept under matching 2000000/80000 policy, reopen under ordinary host ceilings and request inspect/asset slice/export. Retained acceptance grants no authority.

sequences.name: caller-reduces-budget
sequences.request_recipe: Give a caller operation cap of 1 to an otherwise ordinary accepted request; cap cannot enlarge source authority.

sequences.name: cancel-png-or-export
sequences.request_recipe: Cancel after accepted request during metered PNG reconstruction or texture export; preserve prior accepted state and commit no partial artifact. Use actual protocol cancel and retained request/store evidence.

sequences.name: reopen-retry-and-changed-payload
sequences.request_recipe: Reopen identical database and retry identical request ID/payload; recover same outcome. Change image bytes under that request ID and reject the changed payload with the inherited request-conflict diagnostic.

sequences.name: stale-mapping-page
sequences.request_recipe: Use pre-repair page cursor against repaired program/mapping or sibling query; never return mixed revision UVs.

sequences.name: interrupted-publication
sequences.request_recipe: Interrupt durable publication after bytes prepare but before commit; reopen and reconcile actual request/store outcome. No successful partial PNG-bearing artifact.

sequences.name: reordered-transport
sequences.expected: Exact program revision and every source/image byte remain the same.

sequences.name: successful-asset-add
sequences.request_recipe: Insert the exact spare() source declaration from the candidate and add the spare/asymmetric-rgba attachment in one transaction. Verify both commit, the spare asset is inspectable, existing label/source geometry/motion remain unchanged, and the unused spare adds no GLB image.

sequences.name: successful-asset-remove
sequences.request_recipe: Remove the exact spare() declaration and remove spare using its original SHA256 in the same transaction. The complete accepted revision returns exactly to rgb-panel; label bytes remain exact. Removing the asset without removing its source declaration fails OKL-E-ASSET-CLOSURE and preserves the old accepted revision.

sequences.name: stale-asset-metadata-cursor
sequences.request_recipe: Request texture_asset metadata with a one-item page, retain its cursor, accept the mapping repair, and attempt to use the old cursor against the repaired revision. Refuse mixed-revision metadata. Reopening the unchanged store/implementation and resuming the original revision's exact query remains valid.

request_envelope_boundaries.name: agent-request-exact-8mib
request_envelope_boundaries.expected: The envelope byte gate admits the exact boundary; later source or execution diagnostics remain separate and do not count as byte-gate failures.

request_envelope_boundaries.name: agent-request-one-over-8mib
request_envelope_boundaries.expected: The envelope byte gate refuses before source/PNG execution and commits no candidate or request effects.

request_envelope_boundary_construction: Start with the actual valid .13 rgb-panel create envelope. Append a newline and a // comment marker to entry.source. Serialize with sorted keys, compact separators and ensure_ascii=True. Let remaining=target-current_serialized_byte_length, q,r=divmod(remaining,6). Append q U+0000 characters followed by r spaces inside the comment; JSON escaping adds exactly 6*q+r bytes. Assert actual serialized UTF-8 length equals the target and aggregate source UTF-8 bytes remain below 2000000. Submit these exact serialized bytes through the CLI/transport path. This isolates the envelope gate; no claim that later source validation accepts control characters is required.

asset_slice_boundary_probes.name: offset-zero
asset_slice_boundary_probes.expected: Exactly the first original PNG byte, matching metadata and program revision.

asset_slice_boundary_probes.name: maximum-chunk
asset_slice_boundary_probes.expected: Exactly 65536 original bytes; next_offset=65536 and complete=false.

asset_slice_boundary_probes.name: exact-eof
asset_slice_boundary_probes.expected: Empty exact base64 slice, returned_bytes=0, complete=true and no later offset.

merge distinct mapping UV accessors incorrectly
add dangling unused image or texture

limits: These are prescribed cases, not observed passes. Runtime/schema/store-specific envelopes remain an executable verifier's responsibility; inherited diagnostic families must be bound before claiming execution.
